summary: Implemented PRV-02 My Properties with the owner-scoped provider property contract, localized filters and pagination, API-driven actions, safe property projections, and loading, empty, error, retry, and permission states.

verification.notes: Web TypeScript and generated contracts typechecked successfully.
Web source, tests, Playwright configuration, and server linted with zero warnings or errors.

Focused PRV-02 component and loader regression suite passed 7 tests, including query construction, locale direction, safe projections, filters, pagination, anonymous/forbidden sessions, and empty state.
Full Web suite passed 25 Vitest files/161 tests and 76 Node checks. An existing non-fatal MSW warning for an unhandled public article-category request was unrelated to PRV-02.
Contracts, Web client, and Web SSR builds passed; Vite emitted only the existing chunk-size warning.

9/9 PRV-02 desktop journeys passed across Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR, including owner-scoped rows, server filters, pagination, API availableActions, expired-session fail-closed behavior, API permission failure, focus behavior, and visual snapshots.
The committed PRV-02 visual snapshots matched on a second 9/9 browser run.
Runtime inventory contains GET /api/v1/provider/properties as listProviderProperties; no new endpoint was invented.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors while frontend_041 was the only task In Progress.

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified only for the directly necessary /provider/properties route integration; this is an explicitly documented direct integration exception to the selected task Allowed Roots.

The runtime uses the existing owner-scoped provider properties API, server-provided availableActions, and safe PropertyData projection. No Backend runtime, shared contract, OpenAPI, Postman, dependency, or database file was changed.

The in-app browser connector could not initialize because its sandbox metadata lacked sandboxPolicy; executable repository Playwright coverage supplied the browser, visual, focus, locale, and permission evidence.
knownGaps: Provider Dashboard approved device scope remains desktop only.
The application does not render provider IDs, internal notes, assignments, audit data, storage keys, access tokens, refresh tokens, or other private fields in the PRV-02 projection.
